additional_concerns: Footnote 3 is present in da12aecad4e68.u30.3569: "Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission." Both format claims incorrectly describe this authority as missing and omit its mandatory condition.

The source supports XML and prescribed PDF as available submission methods, but does not establish permission on only the extracted conditions. This extraction issue does not establish a defect in formulas answering resubmission-trigger questions.

XML also carries express requirements in da12aecad4e68.u14.2439: "licensed firms that intend to submit STRs via the XML format are required to follow the XML schema provided separately by the JFIU and liaise with it as soon as possible to arrange a technical test to ensure a smooth transition." The schema is unavailable. Liaison to arrange a test must not silently become a requirement to have passed a test.

The prescribed PDF form is unavailable. The packet's four opaque missing-dependency identifiers have no document mapping; the descriptive dependency identifiers below identify missing materials without claiming that mapping.

The date-only candidate includes filings before 9:00am on 2 February 2026. The source separately states a calendar-date channel rule, a 9:00am operational launch and resubmission "following its implementation". Retain the competing temporal interpretations; do not treat either date or instant interpretation as conclusively resolved.

The source does not expressly supply a timezone or resolve inclusion of the exact implementation instant. Instant-based candidates require that authority or an explicit interpretation before their temporal classifications can be established.

Urgent blackout contact is not automatically an actual STR submission. Automatic migration is separately described from submission. Neither should silently supply a qualifying post-implementation event.

The history candidate delegates event existence and history completeness to an external classification. TRUE establishes a historical trigger, not a presently outstanding duty; a later resubmission does not erase the original trigger.

Three event candidates place actual STR filing in scope, whereas node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb places submission in the result. They therefore differ between OUT_OF_SCOPE and FALSE for non-submission events; the intended assessment domain needs to resolve that distinction.
The registration recommendation must retain SHOULD. Neither registration nor e-Cert possession is stated as an additional condition for an actual other-channel submission to trigger resubmission.
